translation.name: Reꞌ Lokꞌ Laj Hu̱j Wilic wi̱ꞌ Ribiral i Jesus

book.name: SAN MATEO
book.title: Reꞌ ribiral i Jesus xitzꞌihmbaj i Maꞌ Tiyoh

content: Reꞌ ribiral chiri̱j hab wach take cho rima̱m ratiꞌt i Jesus

Reꞌ hu̱j tzꞌihmbimaj wi̱ꞌ quibihnal take rima̱m ratiꞌt i Jesus risakomej lok wach chi reꞌ Jesus, reꞌ i Pahbamaj chi Kꞌatal Kꞌoric maj reꞌreꞌ, ra̱ꞌ riꞌsil cho maꞌ Awraham eh ra̱ꞌ riꞌsil woꞌ cho maꞌ Tawiy nqui rikꞌor i hu̱j reꞌreꞌ chi jeꞌ wili:
Reꞌ maꞌ Awraham xacꞌunej cho Isahac, reꞌ Isahac xacꞌunej cho Jacow, reꞌ Jacow xacꞌunej cho Jurah chꞌi̱l take junlaj chi ras richa̱kꞌ,
reꞌ Jurah xacꞌunej cho i Pa̱res chꞌi̱l i Sa̱ra naxicꞌam i Tama̱r chi rehqꞌue̱n, reꞌ Pa̱res xacꞌunej cho Hesrom eh reꞌ Hesrom xacꞌunej cho i Aram.
Reꞌ Aram xacꞌunej cho i Aminaraw, reꞌ Aminaraw xacꞌunej cho i Nahason, reꞌ Nahason xacꞌunej cho i Salmon,
reꞌ Salmon xacꞌunej cho i Wohos naxicꞌam i Rahaw chi rehqꞌue̱n, eh reꞌ Wohos xacꞌunej cho i Ower naxicꞌam i Rut chi rehqꞌue̱n, reꞌ Ower xacꞌunej cho Isayih,
reꞌ Isayih xacꞌunej i Tawiy. Reꞌ Tawiy naxwihꞌic cho chi kꞌatal kꞌoric chi quina̱ take ra̱ꞌ riꞌsil cho Israhel, xacꞌunej cho i Salomon naxicꞌam chi rehqꞌue̱n i rehqꞌue̱n cahnok i Uri̱yas.
Reꞌ Salomon xacꞌunej cho Rowoham, reꞌ Rowoham xacꞌunej cho i Awi̱yas, reꞌ Awi̱yas xacꞌunej cho i A̱sa,
reꞌ A̱sa xacꞌunej cho i Josapat, reꞌ Josapat xacꞌunej cho i Joram, reꞌ Joram xacꞌunej cho i Usi̱yas.
Reꞌ Usi̱yas xacꞌunej cho Jotam, reꞌ Jotam xacꞌunej cho i Acas, reꞌ Acas xacꞌunej cho i Esequi̱yas,
reꞌ Esequi̱yas xacꞌunej cho i Manases, reꞌ Manases xacꞌunej cho Amon, reꞌ Amon xacꞌunej cho Josi̱yas,
eh pa ribihnal i Josi̱yas jenaj queh take racꞌu̱n xacꞌunej cho i Jeconi̱yas chꞌi̱l take richa̱kꞌ, reꞌ xiꞌasjic chiwach take ha̱b nok reꞌ take kama̱m katiꞌt xicꞌamaric je ar pan tinamit Wawilo̱nya.
Nok wilque̱b chic ar Wawilo̱nya, reꞌ Jeconi̱yas xacꞌunej cho Salatyel eh reꞌ Salatyel xiqꞌuihsaj cho i Sorowawel.

Pa ribihnal aj i Sorowawel reꞌ jeꞌ jenaj queh ra̱ꞌ riꞌsil cho ruꞌ xacꞌunej cho Awiyur, eh pa ribihnal i Awiyur, reꞌ jenaj queh ra̱ꞌ riꞌsil cho ruꞌ xacꞌunej cho Elyaquim. Pa ribihnal woꞌ i Elyaquim, reꞌ jenaj queh ra̱ꞌ riꞌsil cho ruꞌ xacꞌunej cho i Asor,

eh pa ribihnal i Asor, reꞌ jenaj queh ra̱ꞌ riꞌsil cho ruꞌ xacꞌunej cho Saroc. Pa ribihnal i Saroc, reꞌ jenaj queh ra̱ꞌ riꞌsil cho ruꞌ xacꞌunej cho i Aquim, eh pa ribihnal i Aquim, reꞌ jenaj queh ra̱ꞌ riꞌsil cho ruꞌ xacꞌunej cho Elyur.

Pa ribihnal i Elyur, reꞌ jenaj queh ra̱ꞌ riꞌsil cho ruꞌ xacꞌunej cho Elya̱sar, eh pa ribihnal i Elya̱sar reꞌ jenaj queh ra̱ꞌ riꞌsil cho ruꞌ xacꞌunej cho i Matan. Pa ribihnal woꞌ i Matan, reꞌ jenaj queh ra̱ꞌ riꞌsil cho ruꞌ xacꞌunej cho i Jacow,

eh pa ribihnal i Jacow, reꞌ jenaj queh ra̱ꞌ riꞌsil cho ruꞌ xacꞌunej cho i Chep reꞌ ribahi̱l i Mari̱ya. Ru̱cꞌ i Mari̱ya wili, ar xasjic i Jesus, nqui rikꞌor i hu̱j reꞌreꞌ. Jeꞌ reꞌ kꞌuruꞌ, chiri̱j i Jesus reꞌ enkakꞌor chi til reꞌ i Pahbamaj chi Kꞌatal Kꞌoric,

kehtꞌalim hab wach take cho rima̱m ratiꞌt, reꞌ take eriban chi enajlajic ri̱j chi xib tik ro̱k chi cꞌacharic caꞌnam cho chi cajlaj buhr quiwi̱ꞌ chi jeꞌ wili: Cu ru̱cꞌ cho maꞌ Awraham cu nponic ru̱cꞌ maꞌ Tawiy wilic cajlaj buhr chi cꞌacharic. Chiri̱j chic cho reꞌreꞌ, cu ru̱cꞌ rikꞌijil quicꞌamaric je kich katinami̱t ar Wawilo̱nya wilic woꞌ cajlaj buhr chi cꞌacharic. Cu ru̱cꞌ cho rikꞌijil reꞌreꞌ, cu nponic ru̱cꞌ rikꞌijil ricꞌacharic kAja̱w Jesus, reꞌ Pahbamaj chi Kꞌatal Kꞌoric, wilic woꞌ cajlaj buhr chi cꞌacharic.
Reꞌ ribiral rasjic i Jesus

Reꞌ asjic xiban i Jesus reꞌ Pahbamaj chi Kꞌatal Kꞌoric jeꞌ wili riwi̱ꞌ: Reꞌ ritu̱t i Jesus reꞌ Mari̱ya ribihnal, nok jaꞌ rituna̱ꞌ ta pe ri̱b chi cꞌacharic richꞌi̱l i Chep, reꞌ xpahkanic reh chi rehqꞌue̱n, xcahnic peꞌ nchel chi yowa̱b ixok chic ruꞌum rajawric i Lokꞌ laj rUxlabal i Dios.

Chi maꞌ rehtꞌalim ta chaj waꞌric chi jeꞌ chic reꞌ riwi̱ꞌ i Mari̱ya, reꞌ Chep maꞌ xa̱j ta nak chic rituna̱b ri̱b richꞌi̱l i Mari̱ya ruꞌum nok til ricꞌam na̱ chi coric nicꞌ nimal rikꞌor i Cꞌuhbal Yeꞌo̱j reh Moyses. Reꞌ cok ruꞌ reh chi maꞌ eta ncahnic i Mari̱ya pan qꞌuixbilal, xa̱j ricana̱b chi maꞌ xikꞌor ta queh take cꞌacharel chaj bih riwi̱ꞌ chi jeꞌ reꞌ naribanam.

Chi jeꞌ reꞌ ricapew-bal i Chep, pan jenaj chakꞌab jenaj raj tzꞌeꞌ wa̱ch i Lokꞌ laj Ajabe̱s Dios xicꞌuhtaj ri̱b reh pa riwiric eh jeꞌ wili xikꞌor reh: «Reꞌ hat Chep, ra̱ꞌ riꞌsil cho maꞌ Tawiy, chacꞌam i Mari̱ya chi awehqꞌue̱n. Ma̱capaj chi mahc chaweh ricꞌamaric chi jeꞌ ricab wilic wi̱ꞌ maj reꞌ haꞌlacꞌun rihkam cho ruꞌ, reꞌ rajawric i Lokꞌ laj Uxlabal xbanic chi xcahnic chi jeꞌ reꞌ, nqui xitakꞌa̱ꞌ cho rikꞌormojic aweh i Dios.

Reꞌreꞌ xitakꞌa̱ꞌ woꞌ rikꞌormojic chi reꞌ haꞌlacꞌun narasjic ru̱cꞌ i Mari̱ya chacoj tak ribihnal chi Jesus reꞌ ra̱j rikꞌorom Aj Coꞌlonel. Jeꞌ reꞌ ribihnal chacoj maj reꞌreꞌ naricoꞌlonic queh awich atinamital chiwach i tiꞌcꞌaxic wilic chi quina̱ ruꞌum quimahc, nqui xikꞌor i raj tzꞌeꞌ wa̱ch i Dios.
Ru̱cꞌ xikꞌor i aj tzꞌeꞌ wa̱ch reꞌreꞌ reh maꞌ Chep, xo̱j elok wach rikꞌorbal i Lokꞌ laj Ajabe̱s Dios rikꞌorom cho ru̱cꞌ chi̱ꞌ raj kꞌorol Cꞌuhbal, reꞌ Isayi̱yas ribihnal
naxikꞌor cho chi jeꞌ wili:

content.text: “Na ilirok chi narasjic i racꞌu̱n jenaj kꞌahxok cahnanak chi yowa̱b ixok chic chi cu jaꞌ wihꞌinak ta ru̱cꞌ winak,
reꞌ hoj ra̱ꞌ riꞌsil cho maꞌ Israhel kakꞌor tak i kꞌoric wili: “Emanwel”, nqui Isayi̱yas.

content: Reꞌ kꞌoric reꞌreꞌ kehtꞌalim i hoj ra̱ꞌ riꞌsil cho maꞌ Israhel maj reꞌreꞌ ra̱j rikꞌorom pan kakꞌorbal reꞌ hewre̱yo ribihnal: “Reꞌ Dios wilic chi kaxilac chi kacoꞌljic”.

Jeꞌ reꞌ kꞌuruꞌ chi ribanaric xkꞌormojic reh ruꞌum raj tzꞌeꞌ wa̱ch i Lokꞌ laj Ajabe̱s Dios, reꞌ Chep naxcꞌaꞌchic ti wach chiwach i wahkꞌek reꞌreꞌ, xo̱j ti ru̱cꞌ i Mari̱ya eh xitikꞌa̱ꞌ woꞌ chic wach chi naricꞌamam ri̱b richꞌi̱l

eh chi jeꞌ reꞌ xquicꞌam qui̱b, xa reꞌ laꞌ ruꞌ cu rehtal asjanak chic i pe̱t racꞌu̱n i Mari̱ya reꞌ xquicoj ribihnal chi Jesus, cu reꞌ aj ruꞌ xquinaꞌbej quiwach pan quicꞌacharic take qui̱b chi cꞌacharel reꞌreꞌ.
